identification: 18ct (750) yellow gold teardrop pendant, 4.1g total, with a faceted pear-cut pale blue stone (likely synthetic spinel, glass or pale topaz, not tested) in a claw setting inside a rope-twist and chain-link double frame; small white metal accent at base; bail stamped 750 plus partly legible maker mark. Value is mainly the gold, with a modest vintage-style premium. Gowans' own sales of plain 18ct pendants of 3 to 4.3g land around $370 to $600 hammer.

entries.note: 18CT GOLD CRUCIFIX PENDANT - 4.3GM. Same weight class, plain gold, no stone. Premium extra. API record seen via local database and Gowans API.
18CT GOLD PENDANT ON 18CT GOLD CHAIN - 3GM TOTAL. Lighter, includes a chain. Premium extra. API record.
18CT GOLD EMERALD & DIAMOND PENDANT - 5.8GM ON CHAIN. Heavier with real gems, so well above this lot. Premium extra. API record.
18CT GOLD OPAL PENDANT ON PLATED CHAIN. Lighter, opal. Premium extra. Local database record.
18CT GOLD PENDANT - 1.4GM. Much lighter, shows roughly $140 per gram when small. Premium extra. API record.
FACETED TOPAZ ON 9CT GOLD CHAIN, pear-cut pale blue stone. Shows the stone itself adds little. Premium extra. Local database record.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline and work) with 18ct pendant blue, 18ct gold pendant, 750 pendant, 18ct 4.1gm, topaz pendant; Gowans API searches for 18ct pendant blue and 18ct gold pendant gm; one WebSearch for 18ct blue topaz pendant Australian auction results (only retail and catalogue snippets, no matching sold price). Melt price could not be fetched (goldprice.org API returned Forbidden), so no melt figure is given; 4.1g gross at 75% is about 3.0g fine gold, so check the current AUD gold price for the floor. eBay sold would help but is closed to us. Fewer than 5 searches because the item is mostly scrap-value jewellery.
viewing_check: Check the bail mark and cartouche for a maker or Italian import mark, confirm 750 is clear, and whether the stone is glass or spinel. Ask for the true weight of the pendant without anything else, and check the white metal accent at the base for solder or repair.
